edges.answer: Plain markdown files on disk, one note per file. The folder is the database.
edges.falsifier: a user needs attachments larger than 10 MB inside a note, or one note is edited from two machines at once

edges.answer: SQLite FTS5 with a trigram tokenizer, one table for every notebook.
SQLite FTS5, one virtual table per notebook.
edges.falsifier: p95 query latency over 200 ms at 50k notes
edges.summary: SQLite FTS5, one virtual table per notebook.
edges.why: p95 hit 340 ms once the synthetic set had ten notebooks: one table each meant ten scans a query

edges.answer: Beside the notes, in .notelit/index.db. Rebuilt on demand, never synced.
edges.falsifier: users sync the notes folder and the index file causes conflicts

edges.answer: No. One command per question, plain text out; pipes are the interface.
